pixls.title: raw.pixls.us open camera sample archive (every sample is CC0)

ofl-fonts.title: Open-licence font families of the Google Fonts catalogue (SIL Open Font License 1.1; each family directory ships its OFL.txt)

noto-cjk.title: Noto Sans CJK subset OpenType/CFF fonts (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

adobe-fonts.title: Adobe Source family OpenType/CFF fonts (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

noto-emoji.title: Noto Color Emoji fonts of the Noto emoji project (SIL Open Font License 1.1)

frictionless-datasets.title: Open data packages of the frictionless data community (each datapackage.json states its licence)

vega-datasets.title: Datasets of the Vega visualization project (datapackage.json states a licence per resource)

parquet-testing.title: Test files of the Apache Parquet format (Apache License 2.0)

dxf-libraries.title: Test drawings of an open-source DXF parser (MIT License), written by AutoCAD, OpenSCAD and other programs

ezdxf-examples.title: Example drawings of the ezdxf library (MIT License), some written by commercial CAD programs

resvg-tests.title: SVG rendering tests of the resvg project, each with the reference picture of the suite (licensed under Apache-2.0 or MIT)

gutenberg.title: Project Gutenberg EPUB and Kindle files of public-domain books

idpf-epub3-samples.title: EPUB 3 sample publications of the IDPF (CC BY-SA 3.0 unless the sample table says otherwise)

govdocs1.title: Documents collected from public .gov web servers (the govdocs1 research corpus; also the source of the real-world corpus run)

verapdf-corpus.title: veraPDF test corpus for ISO 19005 (PDF/A) and ISO 14289 (PDF/UA), CC BY 4.0

pdfjs-corpus.title: PDF files of the PDF.js regression suite (Apache License 2.0)

poi-test-data.title: Office documents from the test data of Apache POI (Apache License 2.0), also part of the real-world corpus

libreoffice-tests.title: Test documents of the LibreOffice source tree (MPL-2.0)

openxml-sdk-tests.title: Test data of the Open XML SDK (MIT License)
